mapper.sql: sp.id, sp.user_id, sp.student_no, sp.class_name, sp.major, sp.grade, sp.counselor_id, sp.dorm_building, sp.dorm_room, sp.political_status, sp.family_contact, sp.family_income_level, sp.status, sp.created_at, sp.updated_at, sp.deleted, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.real_name, ''), u.nickname, u.username) AS name, u.username, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.phone, ''), sp.family_contact) AS phone, COALESCE(NULLIF(c.real_name, ''), c.username) AS counselor_name
FROM student_profile sp LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = sp.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN users c ON c.id = sp.counselor_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student_profile (user_id, student_no, class_name, major, grade, counselor_id, dorm_building, dorm_room, political_status, family_contact, family_income_level, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{studentNo}, #{className}, #{major}, #{grade}, #{counselorId}, #{dormBuilding}, #{dormRoom}, #{politicalStatus}, #{familyContact}, #{familyIncomeLevel}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student_profile sp LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = sp.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE sp.deleted = 0 AND sp.counselor_id = #{counselorId} AND sp.class_name = #{className} AND sp.status = #{status}
AND (u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR sp.student_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR sp.major LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
mapper.update: UPDATE student_profile SET student_no = #{studentNo}, class_name = #{className}, major = #{major}, grade = #{grade}, counselor_id = #{counselorId}, dorm_building = #{dormBuilding}, dorm_room = #{dormRoom}, political_status = #{politicalStatus}, family_contact = #{familyContact}, family_income_level = #{familyIncomeLevel}, status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student_profile WHERE counselor_id = #{counselorId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 'active'

SELECT NULL AS id, u.id AS user_id, COALESCE(u.student_id, '') AS student_no, COALESCE(u.class_name, '') AS class_name, COALESCE(u.major, '') AS major, COALESCE(u.grade, '') AS grade, NULL AS counselor_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.real_name, ''), u.nickname, u.username) AS name, u.username, u.phone, NULL AS counselor_name FROM users u LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON sp.user_id = u.id AND sp.deleted = 0 WHERE u.deleted = 0 AND u.role = 'student' AND u.status = 1 AND sp.id IS NULL ORDER BY u.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users u LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON sp.user_id = u.id AND sp.deleted = 0 WHERE u.deleted = 0 AND u.role = 'student' AND u.status = 1 AND sp.id IS NULL
SELECT DISTINCT sp.class_name FROM student_profile sp WHERE sp.deleted = 0 AND sp.class_name IS NOT NULL AND sp.class_name <> '' AND sp.counselor_id = #{counselorId} ORDER BY sp.class_name
SELECT sp.status AS status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM student_profile sp WHERE sp.deleted = 0 AND sp.counselor_id = #{counselorId} GROUP BY sp.status

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(sp.class_name, ''), '未填班级') AS class_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM student_profile sp WHERE sp.deleted = 0 AND sp.counselor_id = #{counselorId} GROUP BY class_name ORDER BY cnt DESC, class_name
